issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Farm.addAnimal(animal: Animal):boolean (returns boolean), but both the template and the provided solution implement addAnimal(Animal) as void (no return). This inconsistency between the UML and code can confuse students about the expected method signature and return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the UML/problem statement to declare addAnimal(animal: Animal):void to match the template and solution, or (B) change the template and solution addAnimal method to return boolean (e.g., return animals.add(animal)) and update any usages/documentation accordingly.
